name: Zuo Jian
source:
Proud / Anxious / Rebellious

A truant student and the vocalist of a rock band.

Saken looks like he lives by his own rules—skipping class, speaking his mind, and acting like nothing in the world can touch him. Beneath that careless attitude, however, is someone far more fragile than he wants anyone to see.

He may push you away first, but that does not mean he wants you to leave.
